VISUAL MODE
This version uses the cinematic artwork as interactive scene backgrounds, with player movement, spacecraft controls, lasers, and mission events. It is not a full 3D Roblox game. The space scenes are artist impressions.
Educational game — simplified speed and fuel, simulated navigation, fictitious laser equipment and alien mysteries. Real outer-planet expeditions use robotic probes.
